data.body: Plan-review advisory disposition (review #5): the advisory notes the compose-parity test is a static drift guard and no test exercises the NEW container's real REBAR_MCP_AUTH_*/ALLOWED_HOSTS behavior (a wrong auth value passes /health, flips the upstream, suite stays green). Deferred with rationale: the bash-integration tier uses a FAKE docker, so the container never runs real MCP middleware — genuine auth verification is impossible in this tier and belongs to esok's service-level tests + a follow-up e2e. The in-scope failure mode (env DRIFT from compose) IS covered by the compose-parity oracle, which asserts mcp_run_new's docker-run env keys+values and :ro mounts match docker-compose.yml's mcp: service exactly. Recording as a non-blocking deferral per the advisory (non-blocking) process.
